lyrics:
[Intro: electric piano chords, soft rimshot, a clock ticking]

[Verse 1: smooth close male voice]
Seven a.m., before my feet hit the floor
Nine, at the red light, I'm back at your door
Noon, at my desk, with my head in my hand
Every hour, on the hour. I had other plans.

[Chorus: stacked harmonies, deep bass]
On the hour, like a bell
I come looking for you
I thought by now I'd stand up by myself
Turns out I don't want to
Call it weakness, call it anything you choose
On the hour, I come running to you

[Verse 2: voice lower, bass and keys]
There's a garden where you asked your friends
"Stay awake with me. Just one hour." And then
They slept. And you went on alone
So I'd never have to face one on my own

[Chorus: stacked harmonies, deep bass]
On the hour, like a bell
I come looking for you
I thought by now I'd stand up by myself
Turns out I don't want to
Call it weakness, call it anything you choose
Jesus, on the hour, I come running to you

[Bridge: electric piano and voice, the clock ticking]
Three o'clock, the dark hour, the cross
Three a.m., my dark hour, I'm lost
Same you. Both times. There.

[Final Chorus: fullest, falsetto on top]
On the hour, like a bell
I come looking for you
I thought by now I'd stand up by myself
Turns out I don't want to
Call it weakness, call it anything you choose
Jesus, on the hour, I come running to you

[Outro: clock ticking, hummed melody, the ticking stops]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 68 BPM, 4/4 with a lazy swing, D-flat major. A slow, warm neo-soul groove, late-night and unhurried.

VOICE: Male tenor, smooth and close, sliding into falsetto at the ends of lines. Thick harmonies of his own voice in the choruses. The bridge is nearly whispered.

INSTRUMENTS: A Rhodes electric piano, a deep, rounded bass guitar playing behind the beat, a dry kick and a rimshot, a muted electric guitar, soft organ, a ticking clock used as percussion at the start, in the bridge and at the end.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, keys and clock. 0:14 Verse 1. 0:44 Chorus 1. 1:20 Verse 2, the garden. 1:50 Chorus 2, the name. 2:26 Bridge, keys and clock. 2:44 Final chorus. 3:18 Outro, humming, the ticking stops at 3:28.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Late-1990s neo-soul: warm, thick, slightly behind the beat, voice very close, no bright edges.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: 'Same you. Both times. There.' at 2:38, with only the clock.

THE REVEAL: Verse 1 and the first chorus are a man who cannot stay away from someone. Verse 2 at 1:20 is Gethsemane and the sleeping disciples; the second chorus adds the name, and the bridge pairs the hour of the cross with his own worst hour.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Rueful, needing, understood, kept.
